create_maskformer_swin_config: create a MaskFormerSwinConfig instance with default Swin Transformer settings for mask segmentation
initialize_maskformer_swin_model: initialize a MaskFormerSwinModel with a MaskFormerSwinConfig for semantic segmentation
configure_swin_transformer_params: configure Swin Transformer parameters like embed_dim, depths, num_heads, and window_size
set_swin_output_features: set output features and output indices on MaskFormerSwinConfig for backbone feature extraction
access_swin_hidden_size: access the computed hidden_size derived from embed_dim and depths in MaskFormerSwinConfig
